newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were steady in a typically quiet Monday trade amid tighter 180-cst supplies, traders said.
They said 380-cst sellers offered at $106/$107 per tonne and 180-cst at around $110-$111. The offers have widened the 180/380 cst spread to $4.00 per tonne from $3.00.
"The 180-cst supplies are abit tight and the sellers are cautious and have raised their offers. But we will only know later if the $4.00 spread will hold," one supplier said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated at $168 and $178 per tonne, respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3093)
